description: Enhanced text exposition coverage for multiple labels, gauge timestamps omission, negative values, labeled counters, multi-bucket histograms, and summaries with labels.

cases.expected_output:
# HELP temperature_celsius Current temperature
# TYPE temperature_celsius gauge
temperature_celsius{room="lab",sensor="a1"} -12.5

# HELP requests_total Total requests
# TYPE requests_total counter
requests_total{method="GET"} 3.5 5678

# HELP raw_value Raw value
# TYPE raw_value untyped
raw_value{path="/tmp"} -7

# HELP request_duration_seconds Request duration
# TYPE request_duration_seconds histogram
request_duration_seconds_count 4
request_duration_seconds_sum 2.85
request_duration_seconds_bucket{le="0.1"} 2
request_duration_seconds_bucket{le="0.5"} 2
request_duration_seconds_bucket{le="1"} 3
request_duration_seconds_bucket{le="+Inf"} 4

# HELP payload_bytes Payload size
# TYPE payload_bytes summary
payload_bytes_count 3
payload_bytes_sum 60
payload_bytes{quantile="0.5"} 10
payload_bytes{quantile="0.99"} 20
